problem_observed: The toolchain allowed a vertical-connector branch-valve layout to use F2 without evidence and to place the branch tee/valve outside the GD-ST span.
proposed_change: Add deterministic validation/report gates for branch-valve GD-ST containment and F2/F2D evidence basis; update EDPR/KEL instructions to prefer PS unless low-strain-pocket evidence is required.
evidence_requirement: Focused regression tests for failing F2/out-of-span branch-valve layout and passing PS/in-span corrected layout.
